faq.title: Questions you might have
faq.subtitle: If you can't find your answer here, you can always reach our team after signing in.

items.q: What exactly does the AI sales rep do?
items.a: It talks by voice with customers who open your website or shared link, answers their questions based on your own knowledge, demos your product live on screen when needed, and leaves you a summary and lead details at the end of the call.

items.q: How long does setup take? Do I need to code?
items.a: No code is needed. Once you upload your product knowledge and define your rep, you get a shareable link. You can also publish it on your website with a one-line widget snippet.

items.q: What knowledge does the rep use?
items.a: It learns from the documents, videos, website and notes you provide, and grounds its answers in those sources. When a question comes up that it can’t answer, it reports it to you as a knowledge gap instead of making something up.

items.q: Can it see the customer’s screen? How is privacy protected?
items.a: Only if the customer chooses to share their screen, and they can stop sharing at any moment. Screenshots are not stored by default, and team access is limited by roles.
It can speak many languages, including Turkish and English. You choose each rep’s language and tone.

items.q: Does it replace human sales reps?
items.a: It is designed to support your team. The rep handles first conversations 24/7, understands the need and hands qualified customers to your team with a ready summary, so your people can focus on the hottest opportunities.

items.q: What happens after the call ends?
items.a: The call summary, the customer’s interests, buying intent and contact details land in your dashboard. Questions the rep couldn’t answer are listed on the knowledge gaps screen.
